Rationale: Restaurant, menu, lunch, shopping-list and explicit meat/food neighborhoods support the meat sense across these occurrences; preserve the established chicken#meat identity.
Animal, pet, farm and life-cycle neighborhoods support the living-animal sense; preserve the established chicken#animal identity.
These three flat or mixed neighborhoods do not safely distinguish chicken as meat from chicken as the animal; keep them explicitly deferred instead of guessing a partition.
Life, death and environmental contexts consistently support the adjective dead; noun and adverb dictionary senses are not learner evidence here.
Christmas, lights, stars, stockings and presents support the elementary decorate/arrange sense; ceremonial award senses are excluded.
Healthy eating, food pyramid and keep a good diet contexts support diet as one's usual food/eating pattern rather than the narrower verb sense of dieting.
